summary: John's 1st cousin 8x removed if the Doll link holds; the real Revolutionary captain whose 1934 cenotaph stands on Johann Casper Doll's grave.
bio: Capt. Casper Dull (1748-1829), nephew of Johann Casper Doll, was cornet (2nd lieutenant) of the Northampton County Light Dragoons and served as a captain in the Revolution; he later received Butler County donation lands and died at McVeytown, Mifflin Co. (Find a Grave 21956570). In 1934 a monument/cenotaph to him was erected on his uncle's grave at Plainfield - the source of the tree's 'Captain' and flag image.
